submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole reads the token at the current position and is nearly blind to its context (91% of its input attribution sits on the peak token; nine different preceding tokens move a tab from 1.82 to 1.90): it saturates at its maximum (1.5-1.9, scan max 1.59) exactly when the current token is one GPT-2 never saw in training - the vocabulary rows that share its single untrained default embedding (cosine 0.997 between them), namely raw control bytes other than newline (tab, CR, 0x00-0x1F, 0x7F), bytes that cannot occur in valid UTF-8 (0xC0, 0xC1, 0xF5-0xFF), and the Reddit-only 'glitch' tokens (InstoreAndOnline, rawdownload, reportprint, externalToEVA, quickShip, TheNitrome, GoldMagikarp). It sits at the GELU floor (-0.17) on the ordinary vocabulary of running text (function words, common nouns and verbs, punctuation, the space and the newline) and gives graded weaker activity (0.3-1.3) to rare mid-word pieces and near-absent words ('otide' in nucleotide, 'igans' in caddigans, 'pport', 'vernment', ' suffi(ce)', ' apartheid'), so those can clear the 0.40 activity line while ordinary text cannot; a text's very first token never fires.
